tutorial.pageDesc: Learn how to use the risk map, SOS button, My Guardian, Panic Mode, safe routes, reporting, and other features of Criminal Alert.
tutorial.heroDesc: Learn how to use the risk map, SOS button, My Guardian, Panic Mode, safe routes, reporting, and other features of Criminal Alert.
tutorial.mapTitle: 🗺️ How does the Risk Map work?
tutorial.mapDesc: The Risk Map is the primary screen of the application. It displays real-time incidents in your area with detailed pins and a Heatmap view. At the top, use the search bar to find any address and the language button ([🇺🇸] EN) to change languages with one tap. Tap any pin to see photos and videos in full screen. Use the floating action buttons for Guardian Mode, Panic Mode, SOS, or GPS calibration.
tutorial.sosDesc: The red SOS button on the map is enlarged for rapid response and is meant for real emergencies. When activated, it:
tutorial.sosL1: Records ambient audio (10 seconds) with an option to listen and send the audio to your contacts.
tutorial.sosL2: Generates a dedicated emergency link with a live map and integrated audio player.
tutorial.sosL3: Sends an instant WhatsApp emergency alert to your pre-registered Trusted Contacts.
tutorial.sosL4: Offers a quick shortcut to dial the Police (190 / 911).
tutorial.sosNotice: 💡 Safety Tip: Your Trusted Contact does not need to have the app installed to listen to the audio or view the map. The WhatsApp link opens directly in any mobile browser with an instant audio player and emergency police buttons.
tutorial.guardianDesc: Ideal for when you are walking alone, in a ride-share car, or feeling unsafe. When activated, Criminal Alert continuously monitors your location. If you do not confirm that you arrived safely at your destination after the stipulated time, the app sends an automatic alert to your trusted contacts.
tutorial.trackingDesc: For SOS and My Guardian to work without interruptions (since your phone's OS might cut GPS to save battery), follow the 3 golden rules:
tutorial.trackingL1: Do not minimize the app: Leave it open on the screen. The app will prevent the screen from turning off. If you need to hide it, tap the Camouflage (slashed eye) button to turn the screen into a fake Google search while keeping GPS active. Press and hold the screen for 2 seconds to unlock.
tutorial.trackingL2: Precise Location: Ensure GPS permission is set to "Always" or "While using" with High Accuracy enabled.
tutorial.trackingL3: Battery Saver: Avoid turning on the phone's "Battery Saver" mode, as it turns off the GPS antenna.
tutorial.panicDesc: If you are approached and forced to hand over your unlocked phone, tap the Panic Mode button (Moon icon 🌙) in the bottom menu or on the map. The screen will go completely dark and locked, simulating that the phone is turned off or frozen, protecting your data and banking apps. While black, triple tapping or shaking the phone triggers SOS secretly.
tutorial.reportDesc: In the bottom menu, tap the central blue (+) button. The smart GPS will find your exact location. Choose the category (Robbery, Theft, Suspicious, Urban Hazard, etc.), choose whether the alert is Public or restricted to a Private Group, and attach photos, videos, and a description. If you need to correct it later, simply find your alert in the Feed and tap "Edit".
tutorial.blurTitle: 💧 How to blur faces and license plates in incident photos?
tutorial.blurDesc: When tapping (+) Report and attaching a photo (from your camera or gallery), the "Censurar Rostos" (Blur Faces) screen opens automatically before uploading. Slide your finger over people's faces (victims, witnesses, pedestrians, and children) and vehicle license plates to apply an instant blur layer. Adjust the brush width with the "Tamanho do Desfoque" slider and use the Undo (↩️) button if needed. When finished, tap the checkmark (✔️) in the upper right to confirm your report with complete privacy and legal compliance.
tutorial.zeladoriaDesc: Reporting Urban Hazards / Maintenance (such as unlit streets, overgrown bushes, flooded areas, potholes, and fallen wires) is vital for community safety. Neglected areas attract crime and pose life risks. Help prevent assaults and accidents by marking streets on the map that need urgent attention.
tutorial.contactsDesc: Register up to 5 family members or trusted friends with WhatsApp numbers. When activating SOS or My Guardian, a live tracking link with audio recording and your exact location can be shared with them instantly.
tutorial.gpsDesc: Criminal Alert works best on mobile phones, which have a dedicated GPS chip for exact location.
tutorial.gpsMobile: On mobile: Keep "High Accuracy Location" enabled in settings for maximum precision.
tutorial.gpsPc: On a computer (PC): Desktop computers don't have physical GPS. Location is estimated by your internet network. When using a PC, your location might appear a few streets away (or even in your ISP's city).
tutorial.gpsPcTip: PC Tip: If your location is wrong, use the search bar at the top of the map to find the exact address or drag the pin manually when reporting an incident.
tutorial.routesDesc: Go to the navigation menu and enter your destination. Instead of simply showing the fastest path, Criminal Alert will calculate the Safest Route, automatically detouring from streets where crimes have recently occurred.
tutorial.feedDesc: The Feed is your community's social network. Switch between Public Alerts (🚨) and Private Networks (🔒), see real-time incidents, tap "View on map" to jump directly to the spot, and confirm alerts to award the green "Verified" badge.
tutorial.pointsDesc: You accumulate points (XP) whenever you interact positively with the platform: creating accurate reports, confirming third-party alerts, or inviting friends. Upon reaching the Gold Level (500 points), you receive a blue Verified Badge on your profile, giving more credibility to your alerts in the community!
tutorial.installDesc: Criminal Alert does not need to be downloaded from app stores. It is a Progressive Web App (PWA), which means it's lighter and safer.
tutorial.installAndroid: On Android (Chrome): Tap the three dots (⋮) and select "Install app" or "Add to home screen".
tutorial.installIos: On iPhone (Safari): Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen".
tutorial.shareDesc: Help your street protect itself! Just copy the link https://alertacriminal.com.br/ and send it to WhatsApp groups or Facebook. When pasting on WhatsApp, wait 3 seconds for the official thumbnail with the Shield to load before sending.
tutorial.groupsTitle: 👥 How do Private Groups (Neighbor Networks) work?
tutorial.groupsDesc: Create or join Private Networks with your neighbors or family. When reporting an incident, you can choose if it will be Public (visible to everyone in the app) or Private (restricted only to your group members). Private alerts appear on the map with a padlock icon (🔒).
tutorial.languageTitle: 🌐 How to change the App Language?
tutorial.languageDesc: At the top of the map (next to the search bar) and in the Profile > Settings > Language menu, tap the button with the flag and code (e.g. [🇺🇸] EN). A modal will open allowing you to choose between 7 languages: Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Hindi, and Arabic. All screens, alerts, and buttons update in real time.
tutorial.filterTitle: 🌪️ How do Occurrence Filters and the Heatmap work?
tutorial.filterDesc: In the top right corner of the map (next to the language button), tap the Funnel icon to open the filters menu. You can filter by incident category (Robbery/Theft, Suspicious Activity, Urban Hazard, Vandalism, or Other) and enable/disable the Heatmap (criminal heat gradient). When a filter is active, the funnel icon displays a bright blue border with an indicator dot. The Heatmap highlights high-recurrence danger zones with glowing orange and red tones.
tutorial.pinColorsDesc: Pins on the map match the exact colors of the filter categories for instant recognition: Red for Robbery/Theft, Orange for Suspicious Activity, Cyan for Urban Hazard, Yellow for Vandalism, and Gray for Other. The pulsating blue dot represents solely your real-time GPS location.
tutorial.pinDecayNotice: ⏱️ Time Rule: Incidents reported within the first 24 hours display their bright category colors. After 24 hours, pins become faded gray. This lets you immediately distinguish recent live threats from older historical events without clutter or confusion.
tutorial.pinSyncTitle: Color Synchronization & Temporal Decay on the Map:
tutorial.pinSyncDesc: Each filter button features a colored circle matching its pin on the map. Alerts recorded within less than 24 hours show these colors at full intensity. Alerts older than 24 hours appear faded gray, allowing you to immediately distinguish recent threats from historical records.
